The data used for this estimate may differ from your available history. The initial estimate uses up to the last 12 observations of each weekday; the personal model uses eligible continuous history.
Actual purchases in completed salary periods, excluding the current period. These are not previously issued forecasts. Incomplete periods are marked and are not connected by a line.

Alert me when purchases exceed the limit

Choose a limit for one salary period. We compare actual and expected purchases, including cash withdrawals and outgoing external transfers. Leave blank to stop monitoring the limit; this does not change forecasts or block spending.
A reminder before a recorded commitment is due. Choose the number of days; the default is three.
Alert me when a recurring payment increases
Alerts when a recurring payment increases by at least 20% and SAR 10 against three earlier payments. It does not change a commitment automatically.
Turning this off keeps alerts available in the in-app notification center.
Enter a positive amount with up to two decimal places, or leave blank.
Enter a number of days from 1 to 30.

There are known coverage gaps. An uncovered day is not treated as zero spending.
Transactions used refer to the entire analysis history. A covered day need not contain a transaction. Large and out-of-scope transactions are not inherently errors.
Errors evaluate gross purchases over complete days. Positive bias means underestimation. These figures do not guarantee the next forecast’s accuracy.
